snippet.title: Mixed Reality Stealth on Meta Quest | Espire: MR Missions | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Become the ultimate Espire Operative in the world’s first stealth action game that transforms your home into the battlefield. Every new location you play in creates a completely different tactical experience.

ESPIRE: MR MISSIONS is available NOW on the Meta Quest store:
https://www.meta.com/experiences/23942166455393686/

This game supports Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest 3s, Meta Quest Pro and Meta Quest 2. For a limited time, Espire 2 owners receive a copy of Espire: MR Missions for FREE. 

Sneak past OPHIS guards, dodge lasers, and get in intense shootouts using your real furniture for cover.

Our "Espire Spatial Adaptation System" dynamically adapts 30 unique missions around your unique environment. Guards hide behind your sofa, objectives sit on your tables, and every location you play in offers a completely new tactical challenge. Prove you are the ultimate Espire Operative.

Follow us on social media for all things Espire!

Discord: https://discord.gg/EspireVR

Instagram: https://instagram.com/espirevr
